messages.author: e7a71d967e60bb41
messages.subject: Default Quantiles in Boxplot
parts:
Dear All,
Sorry for not letting this thread (or something similar) rest in peace.
I already asked on this list if it was possible to tune the quantile
plot and Hadley suggested a way to do this, see e.g.
http://tinyurl.com/ybmtkh5

However, I now would like simply to know what are the default quantiles
in geom_boxplot (I do not want to get rid of the outliers any longer)
and if I can also supply them by hand (I tried something like extreme
like quantiles=c(0,1) just to see if anything would happen, but the
boxplot remained the same, hence I am on the wrong track).
Many thanks

Lorenzo

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Default Quantiles in Boxplot
parts:
Hi Lorenzo,

The boxplot in ggplot2 is uses the typical 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75
quantiles. These are not parameters because I think it is dangerous
to adjust them - despite what you tell them, people will still
interpret (incorrectly) like all the other boxplots they have seen.

Hadley
